title: Failfast Activation Playbook - KPI Cadence & Readiness Matrix
content:
Purpose:
This compact operational playbook is for short-cycle product activations (pilot -> 10k MAU). Focus: surface the minimum set of signals that let the cross-functional team fail fast, iterate, or push-to-scale. The sheet is used during a 4-week activation window and is intentionally concise for daily cadence.

How to use:
- Owners populate their rows 24h before go/no-go.
- Stand-ups use the Scorecard column to call out trending pass/fail.
- Any Tier-1 gating signal that flips red without a clear mitigation within the window pauses the rollout and triggers escalation.

Glossary:
- Tier-1 signal: immediate stop or rollback (customer data risk, critical SLO breach, security incident).
- Tier-2 signal: degraded but tolerable if mitigation in 3-12 hours (latency outlier, elevated error rate).
- Scorecard: green / amber / red using thresholds below.

Activation summary:
Feature: streaming-moderation-fallbacks (hosted-api)
Launch window: 2026-02-15 -> 2026-03-14 (pilot)
Target cohort: 2 internal customers + open beta (~2k users)
Primary success metric: retention-7d (cohort) >= 18% vs baseline 15%

Daily KPI cadence (rows to keep in sheet):
Owner | Metric | Baseline | Threshold (G/A/R) | Frequency | Source | Action if amber/red
Product | retention-7d | 15% | >=18 / 15-17 / <15 | daily | analytics.prod/activation-retention | Limit cohort, rollback prompt changes, run triage
Eng (runtime) | p95 latency (gen) | 220ms | <=250 / 250-400 / >400 | 15m | console.metrics/gen-p95 | Enable burst pool, reduce batching, fallback model variant
SRE | 5xx rate | 0.02% | <=0.05 / 0.05-0.2 / >0.2 | 15m | monitoring/5xx | Circuit open, route traffic, page oncall
Security | data-leak alerts | 0 | 0 / 1 / >=2 | real-time | security.events | Stop collection, rotate keys, pause and run incident playbook
Cost | $/1k tokens | $1.10 | <=1.40 / 1.40-1.80 / >1.80 | daily | billing/usage | Throttle non-critical traffic, enable quantized model for cohort
UX | NPS (beta) | 35 | >=40 / 30-39 / <30 | weekly | survey/beta-nps | Triage usability bugs, quick patch release

Gating checklist (24h pre-rollout) [owner initials]:
- Feature flag + kill-switch tested [AP] (yes/no)
- Canary route + fallback model verified with synthetic load [MH] (yes/no)
- Rollback plan documented with timeline and owner [PR] (link)
- Privacy & retention reviewed with legal for logs/KV cache [EN] (yes/no)
- SLOs/alerts set in console; pager test completed [SG] (yes/no)
- Customer comms draft ready (email + in-app) [AP] (link)

Escalation matrix (order to page):
1) oncall-sre -> SRE lead (Samir Gupta)
2) eng runtime lead (Miguel Hernandez)
3) product ops lead (Aisha Patel)
4) security lead (Elena Novak)

Decision rules (examples):
- Immediate rollback: any Tier-1 signal within 30m without mitigations (security/data loss).
- Slow quarantine: p95 gen latency >600ms for 20m -> shift traffic to fallback and open incident.
- Progressive hold: retention-7d drops below threshold across 2 daily samples -> pause expansion and triage.

Contingency toggles (ops quick actions):
- route-to-fallback-model: reduces output quality but lowers latency/cost.
- reduce-batch-window: lowers throughput to decrease tail latency.
- restrict-cohort: shrink exposure by ~80% via product flag.
- enable-dedicated-burst: increases cost; requires ops/finance approval.

Open items / notes:
- Need short README for partner SREs on interpreting prefix-cache synthesis logs (tracking PRODOPS-1188).
- Billing toggle (enable-dedicated-burst) needs finance OK for cost center tagging; PR submitted.
- UX survey wired only on Android; iOS + web short-link needed by D-2.

Post-mortem template (if paused/rollback):
One-line outcome; timeline; root cause; mitigation; follow-ups with owner + due date. Keep under one page.

Appendix snippets:
- Toggle fallback: POST /ops/toggles {toggle: fallback, cohort: X} -> confirm via console.events.
- Verify cache priming: run long-prefix synthetic and confirm KV-cache-hit-rate >95% for baseline.

This sheet is designed to reduce cognitive load during activation windows and provide clear, actionable thresholds for product, engineering, SRE, security and ops to act quickly. Fill rows, run cadence, and surface anomalies early.
